So they are adjacent (since only two positions, immediate left or right means they are next to each other). With only two positions, that means they are the two persons; i.e., the pakistani person and the videographer are the two people (since they must be adjacent). So they occupy positions 1 and 2 (order unknown). So the pakistani and videographer are distinct persons (since each attribute unique). So one person is pakistani, the other is videographer; they are adjacent (which is automatically true for 2 persons). So no further restriction beyond that they are not the same person.

2) The person who is a videographer is somewhere to the left of the person who watches animation. So videographer's position < animation-watcher's position. So videographer is left of animation person.

- What is the job of the person who is pakistani?

Thus videographer cannot be at position 2 (rightmost) because then there is no position to its right for animation person (must be left of animation). So videographer must be at position 1. We have job: videographer at position1; thus position2 job is freelancer (since each job used once). So:

Now nationality: pakistani and nigerian each used once. We know pakistani person is adjacent to videographer (position1). Since videographer at position1, adjacent positions are position2 only (immediate left would be none; immediate right is position2). So pakistani must be at position2 (adjacent to videographer at position1). So:

- P2 nationality = pakistani.
- P1 nationality = nigerian (the remaining).

Now movie-genre: animation at position2 (since videographer left of animation). So P2 movie-genre = animation. Then P1 movie-genre = thriller (the remaining).

Check constraints: Pakisan at position2 is immediate right of videographer at position1 (yes). Videographer left of animation: videographer at position1, animation at position2 (yes). All attributes unique per category: jobs: videographer (P1), freelancer (P2) ok. Movie-genre: thriller (P1), animation (P2) ok. Nationality: nigerian (P1), pakistani (P2) ok.

Thus answers:

- What movie genre does the person in position 1 watch? P1 movie-genre = thriller.
